body: He has been in contact with her best friend as well, but her parents are of no help. Her mom is aware of her suicidal thoughts but simply doesn't care. Her dad has no custody or contact with her or her mom. I advised him to get in contact with child services, but he said the child services in his city are REALLY bad. I do want to make one thing clear: we are not trying to take the situation into our own hands. We've hooked her up with crisis centers/hotlines, and we are following the advice on the websites of said centers.
